main.description: Encrypted Circle owner membership, joinedAtVersion map, and pending ACL state in the personal mailbox Space for multi-device Circle owners. rkey = circleId. Ciphertext is DNDK-GCM sealed under the epoch root key and AAD-bound to account DID, collection, and rkey.

ciphertext.description: DNDK-GCM sealed Circle owner state payload under the personal mailbox epoch root key.

epoch.description: Mailbox epoch sequence number whose root key derived the DNDK-GCM key.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this encrypted Circle owner state was written.
